name: gate
assumes: parseDsnFile on a file that opens as an OLE container and, when protected, decrypts
version is the uint16 major and minor at offset 32 of the Library stream
unknown means the design has no Library stream or one shorter than the 36 bytes that end the version
older means major below 3; tested means 3.2 or 3.3, the versions of every design read whole; untested means any other version with major 3 or above
rest_of_parse is whether reading the pages, packages, cache and hierarchy throws
